mentions.name: gethly.com
mentions.description: gethly.com is a hosting and sales platform for digital content creators that now includes Paywall as a Service functionality, letting creators host and sell their content independently without vendor lock-in, with a minimum content price of one cent.
mentions.problem: Creators risk vendor lock-in when relying on third-party platforms to host and sell their digital content.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just finished adding Paywall as a Service functionality into https://gethly.com, which is a hosting and sales platform for digital content creators. This allows creators to host their content on their own without having to vendor lock themselves or anything like that.

evidence.value: I just finished adding Paywall as a Service functionality into https://gethly.com, which is a hosting and sales platform for digital content creators. This allows creators to host their content on their own without having to vendor lock themselves or anything like that.

mentions.name: Gethly.com
mentions.description: Gethly.com is a paywall-as-a-service platform enabling content creators to host their content outside the platform and monetize it. OAuth and OpenID Connect support has been added, with the paywall feature rolling out next month.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am adding OAuth and Open ID Connect to Gethly.com ..which is essentially done, in order to add support for "paywall as a service" feature to enable content creators to host their content outside of the platform. I'll be rolling it out next month.
